ideas.name: any warning on a light-volume day
ideas.why: with participation under 80% of normal, nobody is pushing a trend; called turns come true

ideas.name: flip1 on a heavy-volume day
ideas.why: with participation over 120% of normal, real money is moving; flips carry

ideas.name: any warning in chop (efficiency under 0.25)
ideas.why: when the last 30 minutes went nowhere for the distance travelled, price is rotating and turns follow through

ideas.name: flip1 with an efficient move its way (over 0.35)
ideas.why: a flip at the end of a straight 30-minute move joins a clean trend

ideas.name: any warning in the opening auction
ideas.why: the first 30 minutes are price discovery after the open; momentum readings there are noise (expected to hurt)

ideas.name: flip1 with the overnight box
ideas.why: a flip that agrees with where the 1m box stood at 08:29 joins the overnight session's direction
